Subject: GDPR DPA / SCC selection — next steps

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and suggested next steps on the GDPR / DPA thread: 

- Redwood is typically engaged as a data processor for customer-facing application data. For standard EU controller -> processor transfers we expect to use the 2021 SCCs Module 2 (Controller -> Processor). If Acme uses subprocessors (e.g. our cloud provider) we may also need Module 3 mappings; happy to walk through specifics.
- You mentioned you have an internal DPA request doc and a security questionnaire — can you share those (or point to the Drive link)?
- Next steps from our side: we can provide a signed DPA (standard template), indicate SCC module selection, and confirm SOC 2/HIPAA posture. I cc'd Rishi and Neha from Compliance to help with the details.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) You share the DPA request + security questionnaire (I can collect answers).
2) We confirm SCC Module 2 applicability and provide a DPA draft by EOD Wed (PST).
3) If you want a short call with compliance, suggest Thu 10-11am PT — I can coordinate.

Attachments: — (none from us yet)

Thanks,

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. I've attached our initial security questionnaire and the DPA request document. A few clarifications from our side:

- We are the data controller for patient-facing product telemetry and EHR-linked metadata; Redwood would be a processor for any data you process on our behalf.
- We prefer Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) SCCs for vendor relationships in scope for EU transfers. Please confirm Redwood's recommended module and whether you need us to accept any specific subprocessor flow.
- SOC 2: can you confirm whether Redwood has SOC 2 Type II and the period covered?
- HIPAA: we will need confirmation that Redwood will execute a BAA if the product processes PHI.

Attached: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf, Acme_DPA_Request.docx

Let me know when you can share Redwood's DPA draft and any compliance docs.

Best,
Daniel

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Marissa / Daniel —

Thanks for the details, Marissa, and thanks Daniel for the attachments. Quick answers on Redwood's compliance posture and the SCC question: 

1) SCCs: For the relationship described (Acme = Controller, Redwood = Processor) the applicable module is Module 2 (Controller -> Processor). We will include Module 3 elements where we rely on subprocessors (e.g., cloud infra) to ensure downstream protections are mapped. We'll produce an SCC addendum referencing Module 2 + subprocessors section.

2) DPA: We have a standard DPA we can provide. I'll place a draft in the Drive link Marissa shared and can iterate on any clauses Acme needs to redline.

3) SOC 2 / HIPAA: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) — report period: 2026-05-01 to 2026-11-15. We can provide an executive summary and the SOC 2 attestation under NDA.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workflows and will execute a BAA where the product is used to process PHI. If Acme plans to process PHI with our product, please indicate the specific features/workflows and we will route to our Security team for the BAA.

4) Next steps:
- Marissa: please share Acme's preferred DPA redlines or call out any non-standard clauses.
- Daniel: we can schedule a 30-min compliance call. Suggested times: Tue 4/6 9-11am PT or Wed 4/7 10-12pm PT.

I've uploaded the DPA draft and a compliance summary to the shared Drive: https://drive.redwood/example/acme/dpa-draft

If you'd like, Neha and I can join the call to walk through the SCC module selection and subprocessors.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
